title: EFC Phenomenology vs DESI DR2 BAO: A Comparative Fit Analysis
abstract: This technical note fits a phenomenological dark-energy equation of state w(z), inspired by Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), to seven DESI DR2 BAO measurements using diagonal errors only. The EFC-inspired transition form achieves the lowest chi-squared among models tested (χ2=3.60) versus w0–wa CDM (4.49) and ΛCDM (23.71), providing a necessary but not sufficient consistency check. The work outlines next steps to derive w(z) from EFC field equations and perform multi-probe tests with full covariance.
